testcase.name: manager with FULL_AI or STANDARD_AI capability detector allows normal model loading
releaseAll unloads engines and clears active language
STT load failure propagates exception, cleans up and sets ERROR state
switching to a new language loads its engines and sets it active
TTS load failure cleanly unloads loaded STT, leaves no leaked engine, and propagates exception
switching languages unloads the previous language before loading the next
switching to the already-active language is a no-op
manager with CORE_ONLY capability detector refuses heavy model loading and sets ERROR
ensureCapabilities sets ERROR when requested TTS load fails for active language
unloadIfActive unloads active language and resets to IDLE
default NoOp factory throws rather than pretending to load a real engine
